name: lhm-project-hub
description: LHM project management hub. Owns the agency process layer: sales handover, client onboarding (Tier 1 pipeline), delivery kickoffs (website, landing pages, SEO, GMB, blog, Google Ads), monthly and quarterly reviews, meeting wraps, and client updates. Delegates all delivery work to the specialist hubs; state lives in each client's project-management/ folder plus BasicOps.
